verdict.rationale: Cognee documents an official Python API with memory operations: remember for one-call ingestion and recall for retrieval. The pack contains no evidence of a TypeScript SDK, so only one of the two required languages is shown and API equivalence across SDKs cannot be assessed. Missing for 10: an official TypeScript SDK, documented parity of memory APIs between the Python and TypeScript SDKs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in at least Python and TypeScript with equivalent memory APIs

citations.quote: Store data as permanent graph memory or fast session memory in one call.
The `.remember` operation is the main ingestion entry point in Cognee v1.0. It stores information in memory with a single API call.
The `.recall` operation is the main retrieval entry point in Cognee v1.0.
